job.job_description:
We are looking for passionate AI Engineers to build next-generation enterprise AI solutions powered by Generative AI, Agentic AI, and cloud-native technologies.




Key Skills Required:
AWS Bedrock & Foundation Models
Generative AI & Large Language Models (LLMs)
Agentic AI & Autonomous AI Workflows
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex
Vector Databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS)
Python, FastAPI, REST APIs
Kubernetes, Docker & Microservices
MLOps & AI Model Lifecycle Management
Prompt Engineering & Semantic Search
Intelligent Document Processing (IDP)
CI/CD, DevOps & Cloud-Native Development

What You'll Do:
Design and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications using AWS Bedrock
Build AI Assistants, Copilots, Agentic AI solutions, and RAG platforms
Develop scalable AI services and microservices architectures
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems and business workflows
Build and optimize AI platforms with observability, governance, and security
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Data teams to deliver innovative AI solutions
